note: Three complexes: Goldstone (California), Madrid (Spain), Canberra (Australia). As Earth rotates, the next site picks up the signal.
Each site has one 70-metre (230 ft) dish, the largest and most sensitive.
Each site also has multiple 34-metre (112 ft) dishes and one 26-metre (85 ft) dish.
DSN Now shows live ground-station data, refreshed every 5 seconds, not a schedule.
Spacecraft position and speed are inferred from radio frequency shift (Doppler effect).
Each site is built for continuous contact with several spacecraft at once.
Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on Nov 18 2026, over 16 billion miles away.
